contracts.input_semantics: Typed EvolutionAction + EvolutionGateContext + mandatory append-only gate log.
contracts.output_semantics: Exactly one EvolutionGateReceipt with ALLOW, REJECT, or ESCALATE.
contracts.error_semantics: Missing audit log raises SemanticError; action/policy failures become explicit gate receipts.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Unknown authority or insufficient assurance escalates or rejects; it never becomes implicit ALLOW.
contracts.effect_semantics: Appends the decision receipt to the supplied audit log; does not promote canon.

contracts.input_semantics: Untrusted production action request plus current canonical identity and trusted external authority/governance/attestation context.
contracts.output_semantics: Machine-checkable GardenEvolutionProductionGateReceipt/v1 preserving gate disposition and trusted-context provenance.
contracts.error_semantics: Malformed or self-asserted trusted fields fail closed as visible REJECT receipts.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Missing/unresolvable trusted authority or governance context cannot become ALLOW.
contracts.effect_semantics: Evaluates only; canonical_pointer_changed is always false and MATERIALIZE remains candidate-only.

contracts.input_semantics: One or more typed EvolutionAuthorityEnvelope values, requested verb/resource, and delegation depth.
contracts.output_semantics: Boolean authorization result after conservative authority intersection.
contracts.error_semantics: Empty/incompatible authority composition raises SemanticError rather than granting authority.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Unknown or absent authority is not authorization.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure authority check; mints no envelope and changes no state.

contracts.output_semantics: A derived envelope equal to conservative action/resource intersection and minimum delegation depth.
contracts.error_semantics: Empty or role-incompatible sets raise SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: No authority is inferred from missing envelopes.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure derivation; cannot mint broader authority or canonical-promotion rights.

contracts.input_semantics: DesignEpoch/dependency-bound evolution artifacts plus current epoch/dependency closure.
contracts.output_semantics: Successful return only when every required input is current and admissible for accumulation.
contracts.error_semantics: STALE/UNKNOWN or dependency mismatch raises SemanticError.
contracts.effect_semantics: Validation only; does not mutate artifacts or canonical state.

contracts.input_semantics: Action/epoch/source-root identity plus trusted base/head change paths.
contracts.output_semantics: Hashed governance-classification receipt derived from protected-path rules.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Classification is derived only from supplied trusted diff evidence; request declarations are irrelevant.
contracts.effect_semantics: Produces evidence receipt only; grants no authority or approval.

contracts.input_semantics: Governance receipt plus expected action/DesignEpoch/source-root identity.
contracts.error_semantics: Schema, identity, hash, evidence-source, or re-derived classification mismatch raises SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Unverified governance state cannot be used as an ordinary classification.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure verification; grants no approval or authority.

contracts.input_semantics: Action/epoch/source-root-bound attestation receipts plus external trusted-attestor capability map.
contracts.output_semantics: VerifiedAttestationState derived only from valid APPROVED receipts issued for authorized attestation kinds.
contracts.error_semantics: Unknown issuer/kind, tamper, stale binding, duplicate identity, or malformed evidence raises SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Missing or unverified attestation yields false approval/review state, never implicit approval.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure verification; cannot create trust roots or expand issuer authority.

contracts.output_semantics: GardenEvolutionReasoningValidationReceipt/v1 with derived Compare and proof summaries and authorization_result NOT_EVALUATED_HERE.
contracts.error_semantics: Schema, identity, separation, DO_NOTHING, bidirectional-gap, or proof-derivation mismatch raises SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN proof remains UNKNOWN and cannot become authorization or PASS.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure conformance validation; grants no authority, approval, proof from evidence, or canonical promotion.

contracts.input_semantics: Action/DesignEpoch/source-root-bound algebra usage receipt plus bounded REG-ALGEBRA-001 profile for Process, Policy, Decision, Conformance, Evidence and Bridge.
contracts.output_semantics: GardenEvolutionAlgebraValidationReceipt/v1 separating APPLIED, FRONTIER and conditional NOT_APPLICABLE algebra instances while preserving required frontier count.
contracts.error_semantics: Stale identity, self-asserted trust, unregistered operator, undeclared law, hidden required applicability, or missing non-law acknowledgement raises SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Missing executable signatures remain FRONTIER and never become semantic compliance; conditional Bridge may be NOT_APPLICABLE only with an explicit reason.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure conformance validation; grants no authority and does not mutate Garden v15.5, ActionGate, policy, proof or evidence state.

contracts.input_semantics: Action/DesignEpoch/source-root-bound AAP selection receipt plus conservative repository AAP profile over consequence, irreversibility, authority, novelty, uncertainty, sensitivity, dependency impact, disagreement and hard-policy/safety triggers.
contracts.output_semantics: GardenEvolutionAAPValidationReceipt/v1 with independently derived minimum R/V/S tiers, required module subset and resource-budget disposition.
contracts.error_semantics: Stale identity, understated tier, omitted required module, self-asserted trust/authorization or unsafe budget degradation raises SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Insufficient assurance budget cannot silently lower a mandatory floor; it must reduce authority, transfer control or escalate.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure assurance selection validation; grants no authority, approval, proof, certification or canonical promotion.
